messages:
sara_sales: Quick thread / AcmeEdge wants a joint co-sell POC: Redwood Dedicated inside their VPC, with SSO (SAML/OIDC), customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS), telemetry export, and a simple pricing sketch for bursty traffic. Can we align and do a call tomorrow? cc @ana_partner

ana_partner: Thanks Sara. Requirements from their side: data residency in partner VPC, EU primary region, p90 latency target <=150ms, typical context ~512 tokens with spikes to 2048. Need per-tenant telemetry and audit logs for compliance.

sam_se: I can lead tech presales. Need clarifications: expected sustained QPS vs peak burst? cold-start tolerance? Proposed quick plan: (A) sandbox: 1 small GPU pool + hosted fallback, (B) pilot: 3 reserved GPUs, KV cache, canary rollout. Deliverables: ASCII topology, SSO flow, network egress plan, load test script, answers to security questionnaire.

sara_sales: They said sustained ~15-25 qps, peak ~200 concurrent first month. Cold starts acceptable if warmed, p90 <150ms.

sam_se: Rough topology sketch:
- Partner VPC <-> VPC peering
- Redwood Dedicated subnet (Private)
- Regional gateway + tenant routing -> dedicated pool
- Circuit-breaker to hosted models
I'll attach a tiny k6/curl snippet for basic load tests:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large-v1","input":"Summarize this","max_tokens":256}'
```

lee_eng: Pricing suggestion for co-sell pilot: 3-month pilot, baseline reserve (50% commit) + burst credits billed at usage with 20% partner discount for quarter 1. Provisioning lead time for dedicated GPUs ~10 business days; hosted fallback for faster start.

lee_eng: Telemetry export: we can push aggregated token counts, per-tenant latency histograms, and sampled traces to partner collector. No raw user PII in export. We'll provide telemetry schema + sampling guidance.

ana_partner: They also sent a short vendor security questionnaire (SaaS checklist). Need SOC2 mapping, key locality, and network controls. Can Redwood support customer-managed KMS/HSM?

eng-security-bot: Confirmed: customer-managed KMS supported for Private/Dedicated with HSM. SOC2 pack link: https://s3.example.com/redwood/soc2-pack.pdf. Eng-security will review the questionnaire within 48h.

lee_eng: I'll queue eng-security and draft the network egress diagram + tenancy diagram. Will also prepare a short cover memo mapping answers.

sara_sales: Plan: 1) Kickoff call proposed tomorrow 10:00 PT / confirm? 2) Sam: load harness + topology by EOD. 3) Lee: pricing sketch + security packet by EOD. 4) Ana: confirm partner CIDR, contacts, and telemetry endpoint.

sam_se: Ack. I'll prepare a 1-page runbook for canary rollouts and a minimal load harness.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: 'AcmeEdge joint POC kickoff' scheduled 2026-03-23 10:00 PT. Invites: sara_sales, sam_se, lee_eng, ana_partner, eng-security-bot.

sara_sales: Thanks all / I'll convert this to a 1-page runbook and share before the call. :thumbsup:
